programmes.d: A three-man spacecraft lands on a planet only to discover the wreckage of a spacecraft identical to their own.
A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?
Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.
A lonely man falls in love with a mini museum doll, which he believes is alive.
Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.
A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.
On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.
Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.
In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.
When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...
Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…
A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.
A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.
In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.
A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.
Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.
Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.
A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.
An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.
The Kanamits, 9-foot tall aliens, arrive on Earth with one lofty goal: To Serve Man.
An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.

Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.
A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.
After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.
When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.
Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.
The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.
Adam Grant is trapped in a recurring nightmare, in which he is sentenced to death and executed.
Using the power of mind over matter, Archibald Beechcroft remakes the world to his own specifications.
Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.
Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.
An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.
An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.
